messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: on-call SRE. High-sev: Tenant GammaFin (dedicated pool: gamma-vpc-3) showing sharp regression in docs-extraction quality after quant rollout. Please acknowledge.

tom_sre: acknowledged. Alert details?

leena_ml: short triage: nightly regression runner tripped at 03:44 UTC. Extract F1 for invoice_fields dropped 0.91 -> 0.62 after q5-rand profile applied at 03:35 UTC. Model unchanged (redwood-gpt-2x v3.0.1).

marc_oncall: oof. Deploy metadata?

deploy-bot: deploy id GF-QP-314 applied to gamma-vpc-3 at 2025-11-09T03:35:12Z by leena_ml. Canary 10% -> full 100% at 03:37:00Z.

priya_am: Customer ops pinged support ticket GF-INC-2208 at 03:50 UTC: "parsing misses causing downstream ledger mismatches." Marked P0 by CSM.

leena_ml: confirm only quant profile swap (q4_stable -> q5-rand), no model weight changes. We pulled the canary logs. Some token-level mismatches look correlated to lower precision in numeric parsing.

marc_oncall: plan: 1) isolate gamma-vpc-3 to stop any orchestrator churn 2) pull failing examples 3) roll back quant profile to q4_stable 4) keep customer updated.

incident-bot: Suggested runbook snippet: `isolate -> capture -> rollback -> monitor -> notify`.

marc_oncall: isolating now: `infra pin-pool --pool gamma-vpc-3 --mode maintenance --reason "investigating QA regressions"`

marc_oncall: isolation applied, routing pinned, no downtime reported.

leena_ml: capturing failing prompts to staging bucket (do not delete): s3://incidents/gammafin/2025-11-09/fails-0310.jsonl.gz

tom_sre: what about a hotfix profile instead of full rollback? any quick patch?

leena_ml: we can attempt a targeted quant tweak, but given customer impact I'm biased to revert first to restore baseline. We can then craft a constrained q5' and run A/B on staging.

marc_oncall: agreed. Revert command ready: `redwoodctl quant revert --tenant gammafin --pool gamma-vpc-3 --profile q4_stable --force --reason "production regression"`

deploy-bot: rollback job started ID=ROLL-GF-314 by marc_oncall at 2025-11-09T03:58:07Z

audit-bot: Note: audit log created for rollback ROLL-GF-314. Triggering extra retention of pre/post eval states.

marc_oncall: applying rollback; will drain nodes gradually, keeping min-ready replicas to avoid cold start.

deploy-bot: rollback finished ID=ROLL-GF-314 at 2025-11-09T04:01:18Z STATUS=SUCCESS. gamma-vpc-3 now using q4_stable.

leena_ml: re-running targeted invoice_fields suite: F1 = 0.90 (within baseline). Numerics parsing improved.

priya_am: interim message drafted to GammaFin: "We've identified a quantization profile change as the likely cause of parsing regressions. We've reverted to your previous profile; metrics are returning to baseline. We're collecting detailed diffs and a remediation plan." Send?

marc_oncall: send interim. Ask them for any additional failing examples and promise a follow-up call.

priya_am: sent at 04:12 UTC. CSM replied: "Thanks — will share logs they have. Please keep us updated."

leena_ml: uploaded diffs & artifacts: s3://incidents/gammafin/2025-11-09/diffs.tar.gz and attached to INC-GF-20251109 in tracker.

marc_oncall: mitigation notes for runbook: - disallow automated full-rollouts of new quant profiles to tenant-dedicated pools without tenant opt-in flag `--tenant-approve` - require 24h extended canary window + targeted evaluation on tenant prompt sets prior to full rollout - if regression detected, auto-attenuate to previous profile and flag for manual review.

leena_ml: engineering action: create profile validator that runs a battery of tenant-specific critical prompts (numerics, dates, money) before allowing promotion. Also add an internal gate to block q5-rand family for numeric-heavy tenants unless overridden.

marc_oncall: handoff: I'll stay for 45m to validate stability and then hand to night oncall @tom_sre. Leave detailed notes in incident ticket.

tom_sre: will take at 05:00 UTC, posting status update in 30m.

incident-bot: Reminder: create incident INC-GF-20251109 and attach deploy, eval, and logs.

priya_am: scheduling customer working session tomorrow with GammaFin eng + product to walk through validation and future rollout cadence.

marc_oncall: closing immediate mitigation. Service healthy, metrics stable, customer informed. Leaving incident open for postmortem and action items.

incident-bot: Page resolved for on-call SRE. Incident remains open until postmortem complete.
